papers.summary:
-  We classified 10 files: 2 data, 2 code, 6 documentation.
-  We found 2 tabular data files and extracted 25 columns from 2 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 3 study groups (ex1, ex2, ex3), plus 2 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata). We ran automated data-quality checks on 25 columns; 14 columns have at least one potential issue (8 columns whose name suggests personal information; 4 columns with inconsistent category casing; 4 columns whose values look like personal information; 2 columns whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long). 2 of 2 spreadsheet files have at least one formatting issue (colour coding, merged cells, empty rows/columns, or an offset header).
